basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why property and health claims take too long to settle, using evidence from current claims operations.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Do the diagnostic findings explain the delays in property and health claims?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model Atlântico Seguros should move to and prepare it for the Board.

gate.label: Board-pack sign-off
gate.decision: Is the recommendation ready to go to the Board on March 15, 2027?

workstreams.name: Claims process mapping
workstreams.answers: Where in the settlement process do property and health claims lose time?
activities: Map how property and health claims move to settlement
Identify waiting points and handoffs in the flow
Compare with the motor claims flow improved in 2024

workstreams.name: Leadership interviews
workstreams.answers: What do the COO and the Head of Claims see as the causes of delay?
activities: Interview the COO and the Head of Claims
Collect views on the causes of delay
Synthesize pain points by claim type

workstreams.name: Performance baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do claims take to settle today, and where does customer satisfaction stand?
activities: Measure settlement time for property and health claims
Rank causes of delay by effect on settlement time

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could cut settlement time without lowering customer satisfaction?
activities: Define the criteria for comparing models
Test each model against the success criteria

workstreams.name: Operating model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen model work, and how does Atlântico Seguros move to it?
activities: Detail roles and process flow of the chosen model
Keep the design within the current claims IT system
Sequence the move from the current model

workstreams.name: Report and Board materials
workstreams.answers: How are the findings and the recommendation presented so the Board can decide?
activities: Write the report with findings and recommendations
Review drafts with the COO and the Head of Claims

deliverables.name: Property and health claims process map
Claims operating model options compared on criteria
Detailed design of the chosen claims operating model

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, criteria and access
events.decision: Do the scope, exclusions and success criteria stand as framed?
agenda: Present the plan of work and the steering meetings
Align on success criteria and the out-of-scope items
Confirm access to people and data

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Review process map and interview themes
events.decision: Do the early findings point at the right areas to examine?
agenda: Present the process map and the interview synthesis
Discuss open questions for the baseline

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Do the diagnostic findings explain the delays in property and health claims?
agenda: Present the findings on delays in property and health claims
Review the performance baseline and prioritized causes
Decide whether to proceed to design

events.label: Workshop 1: model options
events.decision: Which claims operating model should go into detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options compared
Discuss fit with the success criteria
Decide which option to take forward

events.label: Board-pack sign-off
events.decision: Is the recommendation ready to go to the Board on March 15, 2027?
agenda: Present the written report and the Board presentation
Review the detailed design and the transition roadmap
Confirm the recommendation for the Board

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; phases are estimated at 5-7 and 6-8 weeks from the archetype ranges, 11-15 weeks in total.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new guidance on claims-handling response times for non-life insurers. Confirm whether it is in scope.
The Board meets on March 15, 2027; the brief gives no start date, so the weeks must be fitted back from that date.
Implementation is not planned: the client wants a diagnostic and a recommendation, and replacing the claims IT system is out of scope.
No Handover phase is planned; the Board presentation sits in Design, and a separate Handover phase can be added if the partner prefers.
